data.title: DataAutomated
data.intro: Making customer signals easier to understand—and act on.
sections: The idea
Bring customer feedback into a connected, multi-tenant platform, with retrieval-assisted analysis and real-time insight delivery.
Engineering focus
Python and FastAPI, PostgreSQL with tenant isolation, Next.js, and event-driven updates. The architecture connects ingestion, grounded AI workflows, and the interface teams use to explore results.
Project context

Launch remains in planning. Explore nine original application screenshots and four Full HD frames from the product website recording. The screens document the interface and its setup states; they do not represent production adoption or customer results.

outreach.title: Automated Structure
outreach.intro: An outreach workflow with structure, grounding, and human judgment.
sections: The idea
Connect research, enrichment, drafting, and review into a deliberate pipeline for commercial real estate outreach.
Engineering focus
A multi-tenant foundation and a LangGraph workflow, with groundedness checks and human review before sending. The work emphasizes clear workflow boundaries and reliable integrations.
Project context
An MVP project. The portfolio illustration presents the workflow concept; it does not represent live sending activity or customer results.

support.title: Customer Support Agent
support.intro: Connected services, built on a deliberate foundation.
sections: The idea
Create a shared foundation for support services, with clear boundaries between the API, worker, scheduler, and voice gateway.
Engineering focus
A Python modular monolith, a separate Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL with tenant isolation, and shared service packaging. Architecture and verification are central to the work.
Interface showcase

Nine supplied portfolio visuals explore operations, conversations, voice, knowledge, quality, channels, policies, and settings. They illustrate the interface direction; the project description covers the underlying architecture and foundation work.

sentinel.title: SentinelAI
sentinel.intro: Turning visual signals into incidents that can be reviewed and understood.
sections: The idea

A full-stack security monitoring project that analyzes uploaded images, video frames, and webcam snapshots with a local vision model. The interface brings risk trends, incident reports, and supporting evidence into one workspace.
Engineering focus

A React and Vite frontend connects to a Java 21 and Spring Boot backend. PostgreSQL stores incident data, Redis supports temporary frame caching, and FFmpeg extracts video frames. LM Studio provides local vision inference using Qwen3-VL.
Project context

The repository documents the analysis pipeline and monitoring features. Seven supplied screenshots show the dashboard, incident reports, live monitor, uploads, and settings. The displayed incidents are project examples; no detection accuracy or production deployment claim is made.

insurance.title: InsuranceLeadBot
insurance.intro: An evidence and policy foundation for insurance workflows, with verifiable records and controlled configuration.
sections: The idea
Build an insurance platform on an evidence-first foundation, with explicit policy and jurisdiction configuration.
Engineering focus

A Python and FastAPI modular monolith with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, cryptographic verification, and a minimal Next.js frontend. The repository includes an evidence ledger, a standalone offline verifier, and fixture-based policy-publication checks.
Project stage

The repository records completion of Phase 0C / Slice 2: the evidence foundation and additive product, policy, and jurisdiction configuration. Insurance product workflows, live contact behavior, and production deployment are not implemented in this baseline.

sourcing.title: FocusedSourcing
sourcing.intro: A traceable evidence foundation for supply assurance, designed around tenant isolation and independently verifiable records.
sections: The idea
Support physical-goods importers with written quality standards, counterparty evidence, independent inspection records, and explicit buyer authorization.
Engineering focus

A Python and FastAPI modular monolith with Next.js, PostgreSQL, row-level tenant isolation, an append-only evidence ledger, durable jobs and an outbox. Signed checkpoints and a standalone offline verifier support independent evidence verification.
Project stage

The current default-branch documentation describes the Phase 0B tenancy and evidence foundation. Product workflows and production adapters remain future work; local fixtures are used to verify the foundation.

divorce.title: DivorceSecretary
divorce.intro: Calm, privacy-focused preparation tools, with clear boundaries between educational guidance and legal advice.
sections: The idea

An organizational and educational preparation platform for people considering divorce, before hiring an attorney or filing. The product direction connects guided roadmaps, document checklists, financial tools, and attorney preparation.
Engineering focus

A Next.js and React frontend with a Python backend and PostgreSQL. Engineering work emphasizes data minimization, grounded guidance, explicit boundaries around legal advice, and automated browser-engine verification.
Project stage

The repository documents an accepted browser-engine testing foundation while broader Phase 2B work continues. The optional zero-knowledge vault is a design contract for later work: uploads remain disabled and no vault route is implemented. Production activation is not claimed.
